# Marieliez Pharmacy

> Neighbourhood pharmacy in Cairo, Egypt, with branches in Nasr City (Al Golf), New Cairo (Highland Park Mall), and El Katameya. Prescriptions, medication counseling, wellness products, dermocosmetics, WhatsApp ordering, and priority handling for urgent needs.

## Areas served

East Cairo and New Cairo compounds and neighbourhoods near Highland Park and El Katameya, including Akoya, SODIC Eastown, Villette, Kattameya Plaza, and EDNC, plus Nasr City / Al Golf. Confirm delivery coverage by WhatsApp when ordering.

## Services

- Prescription fills and refills
- Medication counseling (dosing, interactions, use)
- Everyday wellness essentials
- Online catalog browsing with WhatsApp checkout
- Priority handling for urgent / emergency orders
- Dermocosmetics and haircare (Vichy, Kérastase, La Roche-Posay, L'Oréal, and peer lines)

## How to order

1. Browse https://marieliezpharmacy.com/#shop
2. Add products to the cart
3. Send the order on WhatsApp (+20 112 111 1600 — primary / Tagamo3)
4. For emergencies, WhatsApp or call the same primary number immediately
5. To reach a specific branch, use that branch’s first phone number (WhatsApp)
